title: A new Roblox-flavored text model joins the rotation
summary:
A small garden day: another text model, tidier message plumbing, and a new community project on the map.

The roblox-rp Bedrock model is now available with random selection, adding another route for playful roleplay-style text generation.

Message sanitization moved into a dedicated utility, while text event data received a defined source structure. Less duplicated cleanup logic, more predictable foundations for text features.

Pollix AI was added to the project list, making another community-built use of the infrastructure easier to discover.
